title: GraphK: Variable-Size Graph Generation with Efficient Edge Construction
abstract: arXiv:2608.18777v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph generation models have advanced significantly with deep learning, yet they remain limited in scalability, flexibility, and ability to model underlying structures. We present GraphK, a novel encoder-sampler-decoder framework for graph generation that overcomes these challenges through structural flexibility and computational efficiency. Unlike autoregressive approaches constrained by vocabulary size (i.e. number of nodes in graph generation), GraphK allows for both upscaling (generating graphs with more nodes than the input) and downscaling, providing a flexible control over output graph size. By learning permutation-invariant latent representations and sampling new node embeddings via maximum likelihood estimation, GraphK generalizes across graph sizes and structures. translated_title: GraphK：基于高效边构建的可变尺寸图生成
translated_abstract: 图生成模型随着深度学习的发展取得了显著进步，但在可扩展性、灵活性和底层结构建模能力方面仍存在局限。我们提出了GraphK，一种新颖的编码器-采样器-解码器框架，用于图生成，通过结构灵活性和计算效率克服了这些挑战。与受词汇量（即图生成中的节点数）限制的自回归方法不同，GraphK支持向上扩展（生成比输入更多节点的图）和向下扩展，提供对输出图大小的灵活控制。通过学习排列不变性的潜在表示，并通过最大似然估计采样新的节点嵌入，GraphK在图大小和结构上具有泛化能力。对于边生成，我们采用基于KDTree的潜在空间top-k邻居搜索的边预测方法，降低了计算成本。基于流形平滑性...
tldr: GraphK提出了一种灵活的编码器-采样器-解码器框架，支持任意尺寸图生成，并通过KDTree加速边构建，显著提升可扩展性与效率。
en_tdlr: GraphK introduces a flexible encoder-sampler-decoder framework enabling arbitrary-size graph generation with KDTree-accelerated edge construction, significantly improving scalability and efficiency.
